details:
Some settings are things you only use rarely, but other settings are things you want to use often. Having to navigate the menus and scroll through them to find commonly used settings is annoying and leads to not wanting to use those, resulting in reduces experience.
For example, there is a feature to switch whether your avatar's legs "walk around" as you move, or "stay locked" based on your tracking. I want to toggle this feature whenever I stand up or sit down as an FBT user, so that I walk if I'm standing, but just slide around if I'm sitting, which just visually makes more sense. Having to navigate a lot of menus to do this is annoying. Why can't it be pinned in the quick menu for a single button press from anywhere?
Another example: toggling user nameplates on and off. I like to have nameplates on in public instances where there's lots of new people, but in friends+ I usually know everyone in the instance and prefer nameplates off for better immersion. This would be much easier to toggle if it could be pinned to the quick menu at all times.
title: Feature Request: Pinned Settings
